'''Brennen''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] living on the [[Eternal Empire]] capital of [[Zakuul]]. He was the son of [[the Exalted]], leader of the [[Heralds of Zildrog]], a cult worshipping the mythical serpent-god [[Zildrog]] that controlled the [[Old World]] of Zakuul. In [[3631 BBY]] Brennen was captured by [[SCORPIO|the Lady of Sorrows]], who used him as a hostage to convince his father to come to the [[Razor (Zakuul)|Razor]]. Upon arriving to meet with the Lady of Sorrows, the Heralds were overpowered and all of them were killed. The Exalted himself was personally killed by the Lady, who made Brennen into the new Exalted, leaving him to lead the Heralds.<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Brennen appears in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Fallen Empire]]'' '''Chapter VII: The Lady of Sorrows'''.
